2401: Maliki wand shopkeeper~
Maliki~

You see a powerful but slightly insane mage, now in a frankly ridiculous
red-and-green wizard robe trimmed with white fur.  A sprig of mistletoe
is tucked into his hatband.  He seems oddly pleased with himself.

He is fat and has a content although watchful look on his face.  A display

fine vest of mithril chain mail.  The hat does not come close to softening him.

2401: Center of Christmas Tree Square.~
This is the center of the square.  It is dominated by the trunk of the biggest
Christmas tree you have ever seen.  It must be at least 10 feet in
diameter and one hundred feet tall!  As you look up, you can see some kind
of structure nestles in the branches high above you.  You also see a large
portal carved into the side of the tree, with an unearthly light emanating
from within.  Taking a closer look you see a staircase leading down into
the mighty tree.  Near the base of a tree is a sign.
For the holiday season the tree is strung with popcorn and cranberries.
Smaller evergreens have been placed at the corners of the square and
decorated with bright balls and tinsel.  Several foil wrapped boxes are
arranged under the trees.  In the interests of inclusiveness (or political
correctness if you are a cynic) a creche, a Chanukah menorah and a
set of Kwanzaa candles share equal space.
